n4d859fed5a0.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: India Innovation Index 2021, Major States leader – Manipur
India Innovation Index 2021, North-East and Hill States leader – Karnataka
India Innovation Index 2021, North-East and Hill States leader – Assam
n4d859fed5a0.x: The Global Innovation Index is published by WIPO. In the India Innovation Index 2021 Karnataka led the Major States and Manipur led the North-East and Hill States.

n062c09cc0de.s: Which of the following is identified as a reason for the gap in private R&D spending in India?
o: Excessive private investment in basic research
n062c09cc0de.x: Private risk aversion, weak lab–industry linkages and a shortage of deep-tech capital explain the gap; strong linkages or surplus capital would not.

n816c5b6e9fe.s: What is the legal status of CSIR, set up in September 1942?
o: Autonomous body registered as a society
n816c5b6e9fe.x: CSIR is an autonomous body registered as a society; it is not a statutory corporation.

n77f04421d72.s: Which one of the following is an autonomous body under the Department of Science and Technology?
n77f04421d72.x: ARIES, Nainital is a DST autonomous body. NRDC and CEL are DSIR PSUs, and CDFD is a DBT institute.

necdc75b1026.s: Who chairs BRIC, which integrates 14 DBT institutions?
o: Union Minister of Science and Technology
necdc75b1026.x: BRIC is chaired by the Union S&T Minister; the DBT Secretary is its ex officio Director-General.

n7ff78bc3247.s: NEERI, the CSIR laboratory at Nagpur, was established in:
n7ff78bc3247.x: NEERI was set up in 1958; 1977 is the founding year of CCMB, Hyderabad.

n870bb00812b.s:
Consider the following statements about parent departments:
1. ICMR functions under the Department of Health Research.
2. CSIR functions under the Department of Space.
3. ISRO functions under the Department of Space.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
n870bb00812b.x: ICMR is under DHR and ISRO under the Department of Space; CSIR is under DSIR, so statement 2 is wrong.

nindian-geography-22-42.s: The ICAR Central Soil Salinity Research Institute is located at:
nindian-geography-22-42.x: CSSRI is at Karnal; Bhopal has the soil science institute (IISS).

nap-geography-18-2.s: The National Institute of Ocean Technology (NIOT) is located at:
nap-geography-18-2.x: NIOT is at Thupilipallam, Nellore; Pedavegi, Eluru has IIOPR for oil palm research.

nindian-geography-22-25.s: The ICAR Central Institute for Subtropical Horticulture is located at:
nindian-geography-22-25.x: It is at Lucknow; Jhansi has the Agroforestry institute.

new.s: Which country has the world's highest GERD as a percentage of GDP (about 6.3% in 2023)?
new.x: Israel spends about 6.3% of GDP on R&D, the world's highest; South Korea is 2nd at about 5%.

new.s: India's national target for Gross Expenditure on R&D is:
new.x: The national target is GERD of 2% of GDP; India was at 0.84% in FY 2023-24.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about GERD as % of GDP:
1. India's GERD in FY 2023-24 was a 15-year high.
2. South Korea ranks 2nd in the world at about 5%.
3. China spends more than the USA as a share of GDP.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: India's 0.84% was a 15-year high and South Korea is 2nd at about 5%; China (about 2.4%) is below the USA (about 3.5%).

new.s: Which agency had the largest share of central R&D spending in 2020-21 among DOS, ICAR, DAE and CSIR?
new.x: DOS had 18.4%, ahead of ICAR 12.4%, DAE 11.4% and CSIR 8.2%.

new.s: Which organisation has long been the largest spender in India's central R&D budget (31.6% in 2017-18)?
new.x: DRDO has long been the largest, with 31.6% of central R&D in 2017-18.

new.s: How many PhDs were awarded in India in 2021-22?
new.x: 32,588 PhDs were awarded in 2021-22, the most in Science (7,408).

new.s: Which Andhra Pradesh institution ranked 20th among Indian institutions in the Nature Index 2026?
new.x: IISER Tirupati was 20th among Indian institutions in Nature Index 2026.

new.s: What was India's Global Innovation Index rank in 2025?
new.x: India ranked 38th of 139 in GII 2025, up from 39th in 2024 and 40th in 2022.

new.s: In which year was India ranked 52nd in the Global Innovation Index?
new.x: India was 52nd in 2019; it was 66th in 2016 and 81st in 2015.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Global Innovation Index?
o: It has 5 input and 2 output pillars
It is published by NITI Aayog
new.x: GII is published by WIPO, with 5 input and 2 output pillars; NITI Aayog publishes the India Innovation Index.

new.s: WIPO, publisher of the Global Innovation Index, was established in:
new.x: WIPO was founded in 1967 in Geneva; 1893 is the year of its predecessor bureau.

new.s: The India Innovation Index is published by:
new.x: NITI Aayog publishes it with the Institute for Competitiveness; WIPO publishes the GII.

new.s: What was Andhra Pradesh's rank among Major States in the India Innovation Index 2021?
new.x: AP was 9th among Major States (score 13.32); Telangana was 2nd.

new.s: Which UT/City State led the India Innovation Index 2021 in its category?
new.x: Chandigarh led the UTs and City States category in 2021.

new.s: Under the Patents Act, 1970, a patent is protected for:
new.x: The Patents Act, 1970 gives protection for 20 years.

new.s: Free IP filing facilitation for start-ups is provided under:
new.x: SIPP 2016 gives free start-up IP filing facilitation.

new.s: Under Startup India, a start-up can exit (close) within:
new.x: Startup India allows exit in 90 days, not 30.

new.s: As per the Hurun Global Unicorn Index (Jun 2026), India ranks ____ with 61 unicorns.
new.x: India is 4th with 61 unicorns.

new.s: Which institution in Hyderabad supports agri-start-up incubation?
new.x: MANAGE, Hyderabad supports agri-start-up incubation.

new.s: What is the corpus of the RDI Scheme approved on 1 July 2025?
new.x: The RDI Scheme has Rs 1 lakh crore for private R&D in AI, quantum, biotech and energy.

new.s: According to an Aug 2026 critique, about 80% of ANRF funds went to:
new.x: About 80% of ANRF funds went to IITs (Aug 2026 critique).

new.s: The Department of Science and Technology (DST) was set up in:
new.x: DST was set up in 1971; DSIR came in 1985 and DBT in 1986.

new.s: The National Biotechnology Board (1982) was upgraded into DBT in:
new.x: The National Biotechnology Board of 1982 became DBT in 1986.

new.s: The Director-General of CSIR is also the:
new.x: DG CSIR is also Secretary, DSIR, and heads the Governing Body.

new.s: Who is the ex officio Vice-President of CSIR?
o: Union Minister of Science and Technology
new.x: The Union S&T Minister is Vice-President; the Prime Minister is President.

new.s: The CSIR Central Electrochemical Research Institute (CECRI) is located at:
new.x: CECRI is at Karaikudi, Tamil Nadu, not Kolkata.

new.s: The CSIR Institute of Microbial Technology (IMTECH), which holds the MTCC gene bank, is at:
new.x: IMTECH is at Chandigarh (1984).

new.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
new.x: NGRI (geophysics) is at Hyderabad; CFTRI is at Mysuru, NIO at Goa and CIMAP at Lucknow.

new.s: The world's first non-steroidal oral contraceptive pill, Saheli, was introduced in:
new.x: Saheli (centchroman) of CDRI, Lucknow came in 1991.

new.s: Which CSIR laboratory developed the beam catcher for the FAIR accelerator in Germany?
new.x: CMERI, Durgapur built the beam catcher for FAIR.

new.s: The Centre for DNA Fingerprinting and Diagnostics (CDFD), a DBT institute, is located at:
new.x: CDFD is in Hyderabad.

new.s: Which of the following is a DBT institute, not a CSIR laboratory?
new.x: CIAB, Mohali is a DBT institute; CFTRI, CGCRI and CCMB are CSIR labs.

new.s: Which of the following DBT institutes is INCORRECTLY matched with its location?
new.x: NIPGR is in New Delhi; NIAB and CDFD are the DBT institutes in Hyderabad.

new.s: NM-ICPS, a DST mission launched in 2018, has an outlay of:
new.x: NM-ICPS (2018) has an outlay of Rs 3,660 crore.

new.s: Survey of India (NIGST, Hyderabad) functions under:
new.x: Survey of India is under DST.

new.s: DSIR was set up in:
new.x: DSIR was set up in January 1985; it controls CSIR, NRDC and CEL.

new.s: SERB, now subsumed into ANRF, was originally set up in 2008 as a:
new.x: SERB was a statutory board under the SERB Act 2008.

new.s: INCOIS, Hyderabad, set up in 1999, functions under:
new.x: INCOIS (1999) is under MoES and provides tsunami warnings.

new.s: Which institution has a Regional Centre at Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: The NIO Regional Centre is at Visakhapatnam.

new.s: The Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) functions under:
new.x: DRDO is under the Department of Defence R&D (DDR&D), Ministry of Defence.

new.s: ICAR functions under which department of the Ministry of Agriculture?
new.x: ICAR is under DARE (Dec 1973), Ministry of Agriculture.

new.s: The Indian Council of Forestry Research and Education (ICFRE) was set up in:
new.x: ICFRE was set up in 1986 with HQ at Dehradun; 1906 is FRI's year.

new.s: The Atomic Energy Commission is chaired ex officio by the:
new.x: The AEC (1948) is chaired ex officio by the Secretary, DAE.

new.s: INCOSPAR, the forerunner of ISRO, was set up in 1962 under:
new.x: INCOSPAR (1962) was set up under Vikram Sarabhai and DAE.

new.s: IN-SPACe, the space regulator-promoter for private players, is headquartered at:
new.x: IN-SPACe (2020) is headquartered at Ahmedabad.

new.s: DRDO was established in:
new.x: DRDO was set up in 1958, with HQ at DRDO Bhawan, New Delhi.

new.s: IGCAR, Kalpakkam, is associated with research on:
new.x: IGCAR, Kalpakkam does fast breeder reactor R&D.

new.s: Asia's first research reactor, commissioned in 1956, is:
new.x: APSARA (1956) was Asia's first research reactor; Dhruva is the largest and KAMINI uses U-233.

new.s: Which DAE unit deals with beach-sand minerals and rare earths such as monazite?
new.x: IREL handles beach-sand minerals and rare earths.

new.s: The first Krishi Vigyan Kendra was set up in 1974 at:
new.x: The first KVK was a pilot at Puducherry in 1974, under TNAU.

new.s: The Central Arid Zone Research Institute (CAZRI) is located at:
new.x: CAZRI is at Jodhpur (1959); CIAH and NRC Camel are at Bikaner.

new.s: The ICAR National Research Centre on Seed Spices is located at:
new.x: NRC Seed Spices is at Ajmer; Unjha is a seed-spice trading hub.

new.s: Which of the following ICAR institutes is correctly matched with its location?
new.x: NRRI is at Cuttack; CRIDA is at Hyderabad, CPRI at Shimla and NDRI at Karnal.

new.s: The Tropical Forest Research Institute (TFRI) of ICFRE is located at:
new.x: TFRI is at Jabalpur.

new.s: The Institute of Wood Science and Technology (IWST) is located at:
new.x: IWST is at Bengaluru.

new.s: The ICMR National Institute for Research in Tuberculosis (NIRT) is located at:
new.x: NIRT is at Chennai, not Pune; Pune has NIV.

new.s: The ICMR National Institute of Nutrition (NIN) is located at:
new.x: NIN is at Hyderabad.

new.s: The India-based Neutrino Observatory (INO) is planned in which district of Tamil Nadu?
new.x: INO is at Bodi West Hills, Theni, with TIFR as host.

new.s: Which Indian institution leads both LIGO-India and ITER-India?
new.x: IPR Gandhinagar leads both; NCRA-TIFR leads the Square Kilometre Array.

new.s: The Thirty Meter Telescope, in which India participates through DST and DAE, is sited at:
new.x: TMT is at Mauna Kea, Hawaii; IIA Bengaluru is involved.

new.s: NARL, the space research laboratory in Andhra Pradesh, is located at:
new.x: NARL is at Gadanki; SDSC-SHAR is at Sriharikota.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about CSIR laboratories:
1. CDRI and CIMAP are both located at Lucknow.
2. CSMCRI is located at Bhavnagar, Gujarat.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: CDRI and CIMAP are both in Lucknow, and CSMCRI is at Bhavnagar, so both are correct.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correctly matched with its purpose?
new.x: Ramalingaswami Re-entry Fellowship is for life sciences, not engineering.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about DAE reactors:
1. Dhruva is the largest research reactor.
2. KAMINI is the only U-233-fuelled reactor.
3. APSARA is Asia's first research reactor.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: All three are correct: Dhruva is the largest, KAMINI the only U-233-fuelled and APSARA Asia's first.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about ISRO's commercial and regulatory arms?
new.x: NSIL dates from 2019; Antrix was set up in September 1992.
